name: resistance band side plank glute raise
description: A side plank with a band around the legs while raising the top leg. It works the outer hip and the side of the trunk.
instructions: Put a band around your thighs or ankles and get into a side plank on your forearm.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Raise the top leg up against the band.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
